content.text: Six tiers, tan, brick course plus plate lip on each.
Adding stair-step ties that bridge each tier boundary vertically.
Stronger 2-stud-wide ties across each tier seam on the back face.
Removing my ineffective tie blocks, then capping the ledges with plates — that unifies the build.
Clean pyramid restored. Now a plate cornice around every ledge — that locks it into one structure.
